hero.headline: Convert anything.
hero.body: No internet. No account. No telemetry. Just drag, drop, and convert — on your own machine.

features.title: Features
features.section_title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.section_sub: A single binary. Four file types. Zero network calls. Verto does one thing — convert files — and refuses to be anything else.
features.images_desc: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, GIF — convert between any format with quality control, resize, and presets. HEIC/HEIF accepted as input.
features.documents_desc: Markdown, DOCX, HTML, PDF, ODT, EPUB — powered by Pandoc, no cloud required.
features.audio_desc: MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV, AAC — lossless or lossy, bitrate control included.
features.video_desc: MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV — H.264, H.265, VP9 codecs with resolution options.
features.batch_desc: Drop a folder and Verto recursively enqueues every supported file. Convert dozens of documents or images in one click.
features.queue_desc: Cancel a running batch mid-way, retry individual failed items, and browse a custom output directory — all without restarting the app.
features.history_desc: Every conversion is logged in the session history. Browse past results, check saved file sizes, and reopen output files directly.
features.local_desc: No upload. No cloud. Everything runs on your machine. Your files never leave.
features.opensource_desc: MIT licensed. Audit the code, contribute, or fork it. No black boxes.

privacy.title: Your files stay on your machine.
privacy.body: Verto runs entirely offline. No telemetry, no analytics, no network requests — ever. Your files are processed locally and never leave your device.
